summary: The host_group_vars vars plugin loads group_vars/ and host_vars/ files (.yml, .yaml, .json or no extension), ignoring hidden and backup files, for path-based inventories. It caches content, so mid-play edits don't take effect.
questions: How does Ansible load group_vars and host_vars?
Which file extensions are read from group_vars?
Why don't changes to host_vars during a play take effect?

answer_card.title: group_vars and host_vars loading
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.host_group_vars` loads `group_vars/` and `host_vars/` files with `.yml`, `.yaml`, `.json` or no extension. Hidden (`.`) and backup (`~`) files are ignored. Only for inventory sources that are paths; enabled by default.

It **caches** paths and content, so creating/editing these files mid-play has no effect for hosts already targeted.
